run_SceneMapper: run the SceneMapper process to perform online 3D Gaussian Splatting scene mapping and optimization
optimize_SceneMapper_optimize: optimize Gaussians over the active and global keyframe windows with configurable loss functions
densify_SceneMapper_densification: densify the Gaussian map by adding new Gaussians based on SSIM error and depth rendering
update_SceneMapper_update_kf: update keyframe selection and manage the active window and coarse pool for the current frame
refine_SceneMapper_post_refinement: run post-refinement optimization over all keyframes with random camera sampling and learning rate scheduling
